The '''Kaas City Expansion Project''' was a major undertaking of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. It was aimed at building an [[Kaas City expansion district|large extension]] of [[Kaas City]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] and headquarters of the Empire.<ref name="The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
